# 17 Tauri: Reading a Star in the Catalog

*HIP 17499’s measurements offer a compact introduction to stellar classification, distance and motion.*

A star can be familiar by one name and precise by another. SIMBAD identifies the object discussed here as 17 Tauri, or HIP 17499, and classifies it as a Be star. Its listed spectral type is B6IIIe. Those catalog labels do more than identify a point of light: they summarize how astronomers classify the star and record its properties. [SIMBAD](https://simbad.cds.unistra.fr/simbad/sim-id?Ident=HIP%2017499)

The spectral type can be read in parts. “B6” is the star’s spectral class and subtype; “III” is its luminosity class; and the final “e” denotes emission features in its spectrum.
